summary: Completed comprehensive testing of YouTube Affiliate Prospect Finder MVP redesign. All auth flows (login, signup, logout), page rendering (landing, pricing, dashboard, terms, privacy), and backend auth APIs working correctly. Backend 100% pass rate (9/9 tests), Frontend 100% functional with one minor UI behavior note.

issues: Logout redirects to /login instead of landing page (/) - code has navigate('/') but race condition causes redirect to /login. Functionally acceptable.

Backend: POST /api/auth/login with admin credentials returns token and user (200)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with non-existent user returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with valid token returns user data (200)
Backend: GET /api/auth/me without token returns 401/403
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with invalid token returns 401
